nws_alerts.headline: Winter Storm Warning issued November 19 at 10:20PM MST until November 21 at 11:00AM MST by NWS Salt Lake City UT
nws_alerts.description:
* WHAT...Heavy snow. Total snow accumulations between 12 and 24
inches, highest in the Upper Cottonwoods and near the Utah/Idaho
border.

* WHERE...The Wasatch Mountains.

* WHEN...Until 11 AM MST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Winter driving conditions are expected. Roads, and
especially bridges and overpasses, will likely become slick and
hazardous.

nws_alerts.headline: Winter Storm Warning issued November 20 at 1:25AM MST until November 21 at 5:00AM MST by NWS Pocatello ID
nws_alerts.description:
* WHAT...Heavy snow. Additional snow accumulations between 5 and 19
inches. Winds gusting as high as 45 mph.

* WHERE...Big Hole Mountains and Bear River Range.

* WHEN...Until 5 AM MST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be very difficult to impossible. Areas of
blowing snow could significantly reduce visibility. Gusty winds
could bring down tree branches.

discussion.key_messages: - A Pacific Northwest storm system will bring periods of snow to Utah's mountains through early Saturday, increasingly focused over northern Utah as time goes on. Significant snow accumulations will bring travel difficulties to high elevation routes. Snow levels will drop to northern Utah valley floors Friday night, bringing a chance of accumulating snow. - Freezing temperatures are increasing in probability for the Virgin River corridor near Zion National Park Saturday and Sunday mornings. - Dry conditions are expected over the weekend, with an active pattern continuing into next week as a weaker system impacts primarily northern and central Utah on Monday.
